title: When to spend privacy: optimal allocation in private learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.39954v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Privacy accounting bounds the cumulative privacy cost of Differentially Private Stochastic Gradient Descent but does not determine how to allocate a fixed budget across iterations. We formulate the complete Gaussian noise-variance schedule as an open-loop control under a composed zero-Concentrated Differential Privacy constraint, explicitly accounting for schedule selection. For expected quadratic terminal tracking, we prove that every local minimizer exhausts the certified budget, yielding an exact-budget simplex formulation. We introduce Privacy-Budget Adjoint Mirror Descent (PB-AMD), combining pathwise adjoint gradients with entropic updates that preserve positivity, charge floors, and the prescribed budget. Under regularity and coercivity assumptions, we establish existence and budget stability of optimal schedules, design-to-training utility stability, and deterministic, stochastic, and sample-average stationarity guarantees. translated_title: 何时使用隐私：私有学习中的最优分配
translated_abstract: 隐私会计为差分隐私随机梯度下降（DP-SGD）的累积隐私成本提供了上界约束，但并未确定如何在各训练迭代之间分配固定的隐私预算。我们在组合的零集中差分隐私（zero-Concentrated Differential Privacy）约束下，将完整的高斯噪声方差调度方案表述为一个开环控制问题，并显式地考虑调度选择本身的隐私代价。针对期望二次终端跟踪目标，我们证明每一个局部极小值点都会耗尽经认证的全部预算，从而得到一个精确预算约束下的单纯形表述。我们提出了隐私预算伴随镜像下降算法（Privacy-Budget Adjoint Mirror Descent, PB-AMD），将逐路径伴随梯度与熵式更新相结合，以保持噪声方差的非负性、下界约束以及规定的预算。在正则性与强制性假设下，我们建立了最优调度方案的存在性与预算稳定性、从设计到训练的效用稳定性，以及确定性、随机性和样本平均形式下的平稳性保证。一个……
tldr: 该论文将差分隐私训练中的高斯噪声方差调度表述为隐私预算约束下的开环最优控制问题，证明最优解必然耗尽全部认证预算，并提出PB-AMD算法来高效求解最优的隐私预算分配方案。
en_tdlr: This paper formulates the Gaussian noise-variance schedule in differentially private training as an open-loop optimal control problem under a zCDP budget, proves that every local minimizer exhausts the entire certified budget, and introduces PB-AMD, an adjoint mirror descent algorithm for computing the optimal privacy budget allocation.
